sentence: This project brings researchers together at a conference on computing with DNA and programming molecules.
This project builds a cloud-based tool that uses generative artificial intelligence to find where urban trees are and which species they are.
This project builds hardware that helps robots perceive their surroundings quickly while using little energy.
This project builds a wireless sensor system that keeps monitoring heavy metals in soil.
This project builds an automatic system that names and records plant microRNAs from sequencing data.
This project builds a way for many different devices, including smartphones and computers, to train deep learning models together while sharing data.
This project builds artificial intelligence methods that search huge collections of molecules to find useful ones for drug discovery.
This project studies how fungi and the bacteria living with them change metals and help fungi tolerate metals.
This project builds mathematical models and control methods that reduce vibrations in fast centrifuges whose mass changes as fluid is added or removed.
This project builds printing methods and data models that let a robot print reinforced concrete parts with complex shapes without constant human tuning.
This project builds synthetic circular DNA that copies itself in plant cells without becoming part of the main genome.
This project tests a way of teaching privacy and cybersecurity by looking at the people affected by a technical system.
This project builds statistical tools that show how reliable machine learning results are when data arrive one piece after another.
This project builds a urine test that looks for kidney cancer early, before imaging is needed.
This project studies how additive manufacturing affects the machining of carbon fiber composites and tests cooling and lubrication methods to reduce damage.
This project studies how plasmids compete and change inside bacterial cells by building artificial plasmid systems.
This project uses machine learning on images of fish specimens to find features that tell one fish species from another.
